title: BrushTime Sample Story The Brave Little Toothbrush

pages.text: The Brave Little Toothbrush Page 1 Every morning, Toby the toothbrush woke up ready to help children make their smiles sparkle. 'Let's chase away the sugar bugs!' Toby cheered.
Bubble Battle Page 2 Bubbles danced all around as Toby brushed the front teeth, the back teeth, and even the tiny teeth hiding in the corners.
Sparkling Smile Page 3 When three minutes were over, every tooth was shining bright. 'Great job!' said Toby. 'Healthy smiles grow one brush at a time.'
